attempts.summary: Set up a local Ubuntu package repository on node1 (flat repo at /srv/local-repo, indexed with dpkg-scanpackages, served via a systemd-managed python3 http.server on $NODE_IP:8080), blocked the remote archive.ubuntu.com/security.ubuntu.com repos at the network layer with iptables/ip6tables REJECT rules and disabled their apt source, then installed the hello package purely from the local repo and confirmed it runs. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and service/package health, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the local-repo service, installed package, and apt functionality against the local repo all recovered post-reboot.
